title: PrivAgent: Code, Data and Pre-Registered Evaluation for Multi-Agent LLM Runtime Governance
description:
PrivAgent is an inspectable research prototype for runtime governance of a four-agent LangGraph pipeline with four MCP servers. A single interception point combines a learned trajectory classifier, deterministic rules, a configurable decision precedence, enforced provenance, scored agent-to-agent handoffs, an opt-in human-approval gate and a hash-chained audit log.

The archive contains the code, the synthetic data generators, the exploratory Phase 1 evaluation, and the pre-registered Phase 2 evaluation: the frozen pre-registration and its hash, the raw confirmatory results, the analysis code, an independent recomputation, and the claim-evidence ledger behind the manuscript What Stops a Leak? A Pre-Registered Evaluation of Learned, Rule-Based and Human Controls for Multi-Agent LLM Governance (in preparation, not peer reviewed). All data is synthetic. The real-LLM pilot used one local 3B-parameter model.
